# Give an Hour

> > Give an Hour is a nonprofit organization providing free mental health services to veterans, military families, and communities affected by trauma through a nationwide network of volunteer mental health providers.

Founded to address critical mental health needs, Give an Hour connects licensed mental health professionals with underserved populations including veterans, survivors of mass violence events like the Uvalde shooting, and communities facing mental health challenges. The organization operates through partnerships with major institutions like MLB, the MLB Players Trust, and the American Legion.

## Key Topics

- Veterans mental health support
- Trauma counseling and crisis response
- Military families and PTSD services
- Community mental health access
- Volunteer mental health providers
- Mass violence survivor support
- Suicide prevention programs
- Nonprofit partnerships and grants
- Mental health awareness advocacy
- Uvalde shooting response
- Military Veteran Peer Network
- Dr. Randy Phelps (CEO)
- Trina Clayeux (Leadership)
- MLB mental health partnerships
- Domestic violence prevention

## Crisis Response & Community Support

- [Committed to Long-Term Support in Uvalde](https://giveanhour.org/committed-to-long-term-support-in-uvalde): Long-term trauma counseling for Uvalde shooting survivors and families
- [Free counseling for Uvalde residents](https://giveanhour.org/free-mental-health-clinic-opens-in-uvalde-for-residents-following-deadly-school-shooting): Free bilingual mental health clinic opens for Uvalde shooting survivors
- [Sussex County Mental Health Services Face Covid-19 Challenges](https://giveanhour.org/sussex-county-mental-health-services-face-covid-19-challenges): Sussex County NJ mental health services navigate pandemic challenges
- [Social Justice Summit](https://giveanhour.org/social-justice-summit): Social Justice Summit virtual event on trauma healing and accessibility

## Veterans & Military Support

- [Ensuring a Peaceful Way Home for Warriors](https://giveanhour.org/ensuring-peaceful-way-home): Veteran suicide prevention through Military Veteran Peer Network support
- [Tango Alpha Lima: Raising Mental Health Awareness](https://giveanhour.org/american-legions-tango-alpha-lima-raising-mental-health-awareness): CEO Trina Clayeux discusses veteran mental health on American Legion podcast
- [Give an Hour Provider: Tiffany's Story](https://giveanhour.org/gah-provider-tiffanys-story): Provider story: Tiffany's work with military families and PTSD counseling
- [Partner Update: University Of Phoenix Receives Arizona Veteran Supportive Campus Recertification](https://giveanhour.org/partner-update-university-of-phoenix-receives-arizona-veteran-supportive-campus-recertification): University of Phoenix earns Arizona Veteran Supportive Campus recertification
